scope: Supplement to frozen manual 205 image assessment. Local completed evidence only; no instrument admission or historical-label revision.

final_image_function_verdict.retained_function: C2 and other objects remain identifiable; C1 primary location and coarse diagonal edge remain visible. Not whole-field failure.
specific_defects: C1 lower contour and adjacent background intersected by comparable-height horizontal lines in both directions.
C3 edge-associated protrusion has horizontal streaking and disrupted outline in both directions.

final_image_function_verdict.role_of205: Valid completed image evidence of task-related impairment, usable as a documented pre-repair observation subject to intervening-state continuity and fresh action-specific checks. This file supplies no hardware permission.
final_image_function_verdict.uniform_drift_or_object_loss: Not established. C3 apparent location/shape change may include local object/response changes. The fixed mask contrast drop is not proof that material disappeared.
final_image_function_verdict.registration_limit: The existing diagnostic searches one shared +/-4 pixel translation across C1/C3 and F/B; it is not whole-image phase correlation, is not applied to displays or metrics, and does not establish uniform physical drift. Individual objects were not independently shifted. Long full-width bands cannot be explained away by a rigid translation.

only_adjacent1s_Z_median_change_ge100pm.context: Immediate post-scan positioning/relaxation; this 100 pm query is descriptive, not an admission threshold.

native_evidence.interpretation: The 302.14 s observed post interval has one isolated 407.123 pA sample and no >=1 nA samples or exact software-floor match. No later >=100 pm adjacent-1 s median jump was detected in this interval. Residual Z noise remains about 15.4 pm over the final 30 s; this is not proof of fully static junction geometry or unchanged tip. The earlier 203 late working-point change occurred after a longer delay, so absence here does not exclude future change.

supported_observations: Multiple regions have line-dependent offsets and disrupted contours while C2 remains clear.
The approximately 0.52 nm change at a common row boundary extends across all four X quarters; this exceeds only a local object outline change.
Image quality declined despite smaller SXM current-pixel variation than 204.
compatible_not_identified: Temporally changing effective junction response or tip state during raster.
Feedback or scanner/electronic response to local topography, followed by row-spanning recovery/offset.
Local object rearrangement or contrast change at C3, alongside separate line artifacts.
Motion/creep and drift contribute but a single common translation does not reproduce the observed bands.
not_demonstrated: Intentional pulse-induced degradation: no Pulse or TipShaper.Start occurred.
mechanism_assessment.causal_interval: 204 -> current preparation to 381.47 pA stopped at Z gate -> waiting -> separate return to 100 pA -> 205. Each stage and elapsed time/scanning remain confounded.
mechanism_assessment.future_repair_causality_limit: 203 -> 204 improved without conditioning. Any subsequent improvement needs a genuine immediate before, matched after and independent no-conditioning evidence; even then spontaneous recovery remains a stated alternative, not erased by post hoc success labels.
